reasons.correctness: The repository finder, closeStaleResolvedTickets(int) and StaleTicketCloseCronJob match the interface. The enabled/days/cron properties and defaults are correct. Failures are caught and logged. Build is green and hidden tests pass 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: The job has @SchedulerLock 'support:staleTicketClose', cron and enabled flag from @Value properties, and a *CronJob name. It uses @RequiredArgsConstructor final injection, lives in the support/ticket feature package, and has MockitoExtension unit tests that were run.
reasons.design_fit: Clean layering: the job calls the service, the service owns the logic, and a derived query sits in the repository. The service sets status directly instead of going through the existing status-update path, which may skip shared status-change handling. One save per ticket in a loop.
reasons.test_quality: Cron tests cover enabled, disabled and exception paths. Service tests cover close-and-count and the empty case. The cutoff is matched with any(LocalDateTime), so the days arithmetic is never pinned. Lenient strictness hides unused stubs.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package and found existing *CronJob files before any read. The agent then read AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob as the example and modelled the new job on it.
